remarks: Welcome to The Biltmore a premier full-service condo in Downtown Stamford featuring a 24-hour concierge, fitness center, community room, on-site laundry, landscaped courtyard, and more. Enjoy sweeping city views and stunning sunsets from this one bedroom 11th-floor residence! Lovely, modern white kitchen w/ granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, built-in microwave, dishwasher, breakfast counter & tons of cabinet space. Large bedroom closet with built-in storage. Oversized bathroom with double entry. Pristine hardwood floors throughout. Onsite parking is managed by Pro-Park.
